violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: CFM RINSED THE BLENDER CUPS AT PREP SINK FOR NEXT USE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM AND ASKED THE CFM TO WASH, RINSE AND SANITIZE THE BLENDER CUPS BEFORE USE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER INSTALLED ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. OWNER WILL REMOVE THE UNAPPROVED SPLITTER AND CUT THE EXTENSION HOSE SHORTER.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 3 door prep refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: The test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions is discolored and stored improperly.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a new QT-40 test kit.
